== 20% ==
England are playing Germany in the World Cup final. Just after Germany score their first goal from a penalty, the whistle blows for half-time and England end the first half three goals ahead. In the second half, Germany draw level before England score two late goals to win the game. In total, how many goals were scored in the game?

'''10''': The game was 4-1 at half-time. Germany made it 4-4 before England scored two more goals so it ended 6-4 to England.
